data.content_ref: inline:Derive a refutation-depth label alongside accept/refute/suspend without changing the skeptical semantics: a node is refuted at depth k when it is attacked by a node accepted at depth k-1, depths resolved by node-id tie-break so the computation remains a pure deterministic function of the graph and stays polynomial. The criticizable claim: depth is not invariant under isomorphic relabelling because the tie-break depends on node ids, and on cyclic attack chains the depth labels may be unstable or misleading, so the derived grading could be presented as meaningful evidence when it is an artifact of ordering.
